easyPrerequisites: There is an applicable target for Call to Heel.
description:
Cast Call to Heel by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Lutri without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Call to Heel.
Resolve the Call to Heel copy, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
